clues.text: A prophet told to preach against Nineveh went down to this port and found a ship bound for Tarshish.
A disciple named Tabitha, always busy with works of kindness and charity, lived in this town.
After Peter raised a dead woman to life here, word spread through the town and many believed.
Peter stayed for several days in this town with a tanner named Simon.
An angel told Cornelius the centurion at Caesarea to send men to this town to call for Peter.
Peter was praying in this city when, in a trance, he saw a large sheet let down from heaven.
For Solomon's temple, logs from Lebanon were to be floated as rafts by sea down to this place.

taken: A disciple living in Joppa, she was always busy with works of kindness and charity.
